newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end flat, Wolford fizzes.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end flat, Wolford fizzes.

text.p: Stocks in Vienna ended barely changed on Wednesday after a quiet session centring around selective demand of individual issues.

Traders see the ATX index of 21 blue chips tethered to a narrow range on Thursday in the absence of fresh incentives and at around 1,120 points when December futures and options contracts expire the following day.
The ATX index lost just 0.36 points, or 0.03 percent, to close at 1,125.76, with nine shares advancing, 12 falling, and one unchanged.
"It was a comatose session. Turnover from the investor side was very modest," lamented one trader.
But traders cited follow-through buying above all from abroad for the stock of luxury lingerie and hosiery maker Wolford after good first-half earnings released on Monday.
Oil and chemicals group OMV also saw demand, firming to another high for the year at 1,216.5, up three schillings on the day.
The day's poorest performer was chip-maker AMS, shedding 2.04 percent to end at 834.6.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index added on 0.46 points, or 0.11 percent, to 425.08.
The December ATX future lost 1.7 points to 1,121.0 on turnover of 2,262 contracts. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 254
